run_parallel_map: run a function in parallel across a list of files using multiprocessing Pool
run_parallel_from_glob: run a function in parallel across files matching a glob pattern with recursive search
load_raw_jsonl: load a JSONL file line by line into a list of JSON objects with error handling
get_metrics: load metrics from a JSONL file and merge with config.yaml params into a normalized DataFrame
get_merged_df: merge metrics DataFrames from multiple JSONL files matching a glob pattern into a single DataFrame
